issue.body:
### What happened?

We recently started observing illegal instruction exceptions from our CPU CI workflows running on the Azure cpu builder runners.

https://github.com/nod-ai/shark-ai/actions/runs/18839715329/job/53748837375?pr=2599
https://github.com/nod-ai/shark-ai/actions/runs/18856882495/job/53806813071?pr=2595
https://github.com/nod-ai/shark-ai/actions/runs/18889197333/job/53912478770

```
Machine name: 'azure-cpubuilder-linux-scale-v24f9-runner-dgkv7'
Machine name: 'azure-cpubuilder-linux-scale-v24f9-runner-5t7ps'
Machine name: 'azure-cpubuilder-linux-scale-v24f9-runner-b9bv6'
```

There are specific targets which consistently fail, but the failure is hard to hit consistently (likely depends on the specific azure host assigned to the job and which features it supports). 

As an ablation experiment, @AaronStGeorge  ran this in CI repeatedly with and without `--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu=host`. Of ~160 runs, it hit ILLEGAL 4 times with `--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu=host` and none without. This seems to indicate some code generated by IREE/LLVM is leaking some arch specific optimizations which are not really supported by the underlying host.


```
17/52 Test #43: fusilli_conv_samples_conv_dgrad_nhwc_krsc ....................***Exception: Illegal  0.49 sec
21/52 Test #47: fusilli_benchmark_conv2d_nchw_fp32 ...........................***Exception: Illegal  0.58 sec
....
83% tests passed, 9 tests failed out of 52

Total Test time (real) =   6.72 sec

The following tests FAILED:
	 35 - fusilli_conv_samples_conv_fprop_nhwc_krsc_with_pad (ILLEGAL)
	 43 - fusilli_conv_samples_conv_dgrad_nhwc_krsc (ILLEGAL)
	 45 - fusilli_pointwise_samples_pointwise_unary_ops (ILLEGAL)
	 47 - fusilli_benchmark_conv2d_nchw_fp32 (ILLEGAL)
	 48 - fusilli_benchmark_conv2d_nhwc_fp16 (ILLEGAL)
	 49 - fusilli_benchmark_conv3d_ndhwc_bf16 (ILLEGAL)
	 50 - benchmark_conv2d_nchw_fp32_bias (ILLEGAL)
	 51 - benchmark_conv3d_ndhwc_bf16_bias (ILLEGAL)
	 52 - benchmark_conv2d_nhwc_fp16_bias (ILLEGAL)
Errors while running CTest
Error: Process completed with exit code 8.
```

I'm attaching the IR for one of the above tests along with the compile command: https://gist.github.com/sjain-stanford/20fc76277e5818938900c139b3aaf4be

If it helps:
```
$ iree-compile --version
IREE (https://iree.dev):
  IREE compiler version 3.9.0rc20251022 @ 6e7fe96fe4a7062002dd1ac67b83bce23bd60e24
  LLVM version 22.0.0git
  Optimized build
```

### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

issue.body:
Reverts iree-org/iree#22036

The commit seems to be the root cause of the illegal CPU instructions. We produce different codegen artifact with and without the change.

To repro:

```
iree-compile ~/repro.mlir -o /tmp/z.vmfb --iree-hal-dump-executable-binaries-to=/tmp/z`
md5sum /tmp/z/module_jit_eval_dispatch_0_embedded_elf_x86_64.so
```

`repro.mlir`: https://gist.github.com/hanhanW/43ffdd9a84144ec4fc8e4b5a5b450f7e

Without the change: the md5sum is `d5462d72f7ddc97c1a1c28e65cf614ff`.

With the change, the md5sum is `8edeadc38d332b514bd36102186a5b2a`.

The author agreed on reverting the change; will help investigate it later: https://discord.com/channels/689900678990135345/689957613152239638/1433570268307132589
